item.title: afaqs! Foxglove Awards 2026: Marking 11 years of spotlighting young agencies
item.description: The afaqs! Foxglove Awards return for their 2026 edition, marking 11 years of recognising and rewarding India’s youngest creative agencies. item.description: After two years of leading marketing at Hyatt Hotels in India and South West Asia, Deepa Krishnan has moved to Edelweiss Alternate Asset Advisors as its head of marketing. item.title: Old Hindi songs are making a comeback in advertising
item.description: While Instagram and social media are nudging users to revisit how they looked in 2016 through a now viral trend, some advertisers are travelling further back in time. Recent campaigns from Mahindra Thar Roxx, Fogg and Bellavita have turned to Hindi film songs from the 1970s and 1990s to anchor their storytelling. In a less than 10-day old ad, Mahindra Thar Roxx features actor Abhay Deol driving through open roads as Aaj Ki Raat Koi Aane Ko Hai from the 1973 film Anamika plays in the background.

item.title: Wondrlab Network appoints Ishaan Balvani as Creative Lead – Digital

item.title: ZOFF Foods appoints Harpreet Singh as Head of Supply
item.description: ZOFF Foods, a Raipur-based FMCG brand with a strong presence in whole spices and essentials, has announced the appointment of Harpreet Singh as head of supply. item.title: Rajnigandha turns the spotlight on its blending process in new TVC
item.description: Rajnigandha has released a new ingredient-focused television commercial that centres on the process behind the creation of its mouth freshener. item.title: Snap sets up Specs Inc as standalone smart eyewear business
item.description: Snap has established Specs Inc as a separate, wholly owned subsidiary to house its smart glasses business, marking a structural shift as it moves closer to launching the product publicly later this year. The move is aimed at giving the eyewear business greater operational focus and independence within Snap, while allowing flexibility for partnerships, capital arrangements and potential minority investment.
